split.evaluation: one-step-ahead walk-forward; lagged sales use only observations available before each prediction date

input_availability: Opening stock, planned price/discount, expiry time, calendar, and prior-day sales are inputs; same-day sales, temperature, stockout, and waste outcomes are excluded.

model_selection.method: expanding-window validation on training dates; lowest mean MAE selected

target_distribution_note: The target is highly zero-inflated; the selected median baseline may predict zero for every row and therefore has low recall for nonzero waste events.
